server_json: DCPI grid-power scores for {markets} markets, plus capacity to buy or lease; query and cite.
smithery_yaml: Data Center Power Index (DCPI): a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across {markets} markets. Live electricity, power-grid and energy intelligence for AI agents — and the data centers drawing on it. Real-time utility and grid telemetry from {live_feeds} independent feeds: every US ISO (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE) plus {eia_ba_floor} EIA balancing authorities, Great Britain, {eu_zones} European ENTSO-E bidding zones, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Brazil and Australia — fuel mix, renewable share and demand, right now. Plus {generating_units_global|k} global power generating units across every status (operating, planned, cancelled, shelved, retired — a unit inventory, not a plant count), {power_plants_us|k} US power plants, {substations} substations, {transmission_lines|bare} transmission lines, {gas_pipelines|k} gas pipeline segments, electricity and natural-gas price feeds, renewable-generation data, and live ISO interconnection-queue snapshots with queue depth and per-ISO BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID verdicts. On the demand side: a global data-center facility map across {countries} countries {facility_pending}, {markets} markets scored daily with DCPI, {fiber_routes|bare} fiber routes, tax incentives, water risk, per-facility tenants and {deals} tracked M&A deals. {tool_count} tools. Every figure is citable and carries an as_of timestamp, and the ingest layer publishes its own freshness at /api/v1/ops/deadman — the only electricity, grid-interconnection and data-center intelligence source an LLM can both query and cite. Free to start (no key: previews; a free key: previews plus {free_key_full} full answers per tool per day; with an email: {identified_calls}/day) — then paid plans: dchub.cloud/pricing.
mcp_server_json: Real-time data-center, power & energy intelligence: {facility_prose} across {countries} countries, {substations} substations, live power-grid telemetry for {us_isos} live US ISOs + {eia_ba_floor} balancing authorities + international feeds, transmission lines, fiber routes, gas pipelines, renewable-energy & gas-price feeds, interconnection-queue snapshots, daily DCPI BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID verdicts, M&A pipeline ({deals} tracked deals), AI Capacity Index, and a hyperscaler $1B+ deal tracker. The only MCP server combining facility, infrastructure, power, energy and live grid data into one queryable interface for AI agents doing data-center site selection, energy and renewables analysis, or hyperscale market research — and the only data center intelligence source with a live MCP server and CC-BY-4.0 data an LLM can both query and cite. Liveness is checkable, not claimed: every response carries an `as_of`, and the ingest layer itself is public and keyless at /api/v1/ops/deadman — every tracked feed with its last run, the rows it actually wrote, and whether it is overdue, including the late ones. DC Hub Capacity Source adds the supply side: powered land, powered shells, turnkey capacity and colocation to buy or lease — including sites that are not publicly marketed — searched by size (kW or MW) and location with source_capacity and browsable at https://dchub.cloud/listings; an introduction is a deal registration, so identity, site and contact are exchanged only if the provider accepts. {free_tier_rule} Then paid plans: dchub.cloud/pricing.
